question: Can existing placement, custody/provenance and internal-structure evidence uniquely constrain the pre-Veta identity, or does the reverse map remain one-to-many?

frozen_model.identity_invariant_required: A preregistered property that survives both forward and reverse passes and distinguishes ORIGINAL_X from SURROGATE_X_PRIME without semantic retuning

runs.reason: No independently established provenance chain currently binds a candidate original Osirian member to the Mendes human funerary object chain.

Existing reverse-only Tranception work independently predicts Mendes as an Osirian phallus/body-part node and shows that a human funerary phallus sheath in the Mendes priestly context is compatible with that local ritual ecology without implying unique original identity.

runs.input: gold/modelled genital cover or replacement object class
runs.reason: Matched controls include Saqqara female gold genital covering, KHM insertable Osiris genital module and Qurna genital model beneath intact human genitalia; morphology/material/function do not uniquely identify one origin.

runs.input: CG53469/JE35425 plus known Mendes burial provenance
runs.reason: Reverse trace recovers the Nesbanebdjedet human funerary burial at Mendes and the wider Mendes Osirian phallus/relic geography, but it does not continue uniquely to an original divine member.
runs.rollback_point: MENDES HUMAN FUNERARY CONTEXT / OSIRIAN PRIESTLY ASSOCIATION

runs.input: same or similar genital/restorative function, different provenance
runs.reason: Comparable genital covers/models demonstrate that restoration or genital symbolism can recur outside the target provenance.

runs.input: same Mendes/Osirian provenance geography without assuming object identity
runs.reason: Mendes independently carries Osirian phallus/backbone relic geography and rejuvenation semantics, but locality and cult function alone do not select CG53469 as a unique original member.

tranception_summary.BACK: reaches Mendes/human funerary provenance but branches before unique original identity
tranception_summary.FORWARD: surrogate/funerary model reaches the observed object class more cleanly than the unanchored original-member model
tranception_summary.RIGHT: provenance-matched Mendes control remains viable without unique identity
tranception_summary.FORWARD_AGAIN: predicts that any successful promotion must add a new identity-bearing invariant from placement, custody, residues, seams, internal structure, inscription or directly continuous provenance
tranception_summary.BACK_AGAIN: rollback remains at the earliest independently supported Mendes human funerary/Osirian node; do not backfill a unique original-member identity

Sah_identity_analogue.mapping: The preserved S__ḥ frame is analogous to preserved context/function; replacement of the center is analogous to loss of provenance-sensitive identity.
Sah_identity_analogue.result: A compatible outer frame plus compatible function cannot reconstruct the original center. The external anchor must carry the missing identity information.

A_PLACEMENT.need: Exact Quibell/Vernier/object-card placement of CG53469 relative to the mummy and neighboring gold trappings.

B_CUSTODY.need: Resolve CG53465-53469 item-by-item, transfer history and any missing/removed assemblage components.

C_INTERNAL_STRUCTURE.need: Conservation/imaging evidence for seams, residues, support impressions, repairs, cavities, nested material or manufacture traces.

next_gate.rule: Freeze expected discriminators before reading the records. A single positive-looking feature cannot promote identity if the other two channels remain non-unique.
next_gate.pass_condition: At least two independent channels must converge on the same identity-bearing invariant and the reverse pass must select one pre-Veta history over matched surrogate histories without semantic retuning.
next_gate.fail_condition: If the channels only recover object class, local cult function or generic funerary placement, keep the reverse map one-to-many and retain surrogate/original as unresolved competing models.

canonical_line: THE NEXT GATE DOES NOT ASK WHETHER THE OBJECT LOOKS RIGHT. IT ASKS WHETHER REVERSE PROVENANCE CAN SELECT ONE HISTORY AFTER VETA.
